title: [FEATURE] Support gitlab in ultraplan
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

I want to use ultraplan because this is a great idea. Reviewing and updating plans on a text interface is not convenient. 
But my repos are on gitlab, I cannot move them and should not have to.

Can you support Gitlab as well as Github? 

### Proposed Solution

Add Gitlab support to Claude Code to match Github.
